analysis.title: GS Korea Final: All Eyes on SK Hynix (28 Oct 2026)
key_insights: KOSPI rose 6.63% to 6012.4, back above the 6,000 level, led by the AI supply chain after SK Hynix's 3Q earnings print and conference call helped restore investor confidence in AI.

SK Hynix rose 10.9% after reporting 3Q operating profit of W83.3tn, an 8% beat versus BBGe W76.9tn and GSe W77.5tn. The initial price action was mild, which appeared to reflect a buyback smaller than expected.
SK Hynix announced a W100tn total shareholder return package for 2026, including a W20tn buyback. Street consensus for the buyback was around W30tn-W40tn. The W100tn total was in line with estimates.

On the conference call, SK Hynix management said the memory shortage is expected to continue through 2030 and much of its DRAM capacity is sold out through 2029. It also said it has secured long-term agreement volumes covering more than 50% of total production capacity for 2027-2028.
Samsung Electronics (SEC) rose 9.0%. Its 3Q earnings call is tomorrow at 10AM KST, and investors will look for further detail on shareholder returns.
SEMCO rose 8.7% after 3Q operating profit of W691bn, a 5% beat versus BBGe W660.2bn.
Foreigners and local institutions extended a 2-day net-buying streak in KOSPI, concentrated in Tech (+$585mn foreigners, +$638mn locals). Retail investors took profits (-$1,346mn).

Korean robotics stocks rallied on reports that Madison Huang of Nvidia is expected to visit Korea on Nov 8-9 for Nvidia AI Day Seoul 2026. Doosan Robotics rose 6.9%, Rainbow Robotics 15.1% and Robotis 9.8%.
KOSDAQ rose 3.69% to 771.3. KOSPI turnover was 11.6% above its 20-day average. KRW weakened 106bps to W1,338.2.

market_movers.rationale: SK Hynix (000660) rose 10.9% after an 8% 3Q operating profit beat and a W100tn 2026 shareholder return package.
Samsung Electronics (005930) rose 9.0% in the semiconductor rally. Its 3Q earnings call tomorrow is a watch point for shareholder return details.
SEMCO (009150) rose 8.7% after 3Q operating profit of W691bn beat BBGe W660.2bn by 5%.
Doosan Robotics (454910) rose 6.9%, Rainbow Robotics (277810) 15.1% and Robotis (108490) 9.8% on news of an Nvidia robotics executive's planned Korea visit.

sector_views.rationale: Day's recap describes semis as the positive driver of KOSPI, supported by SK Hynix commentary on a memory shortage lasting through 2030 and long-term contract coverage.
Korean robotics names rose on expectations of closer Nvidia physical-AI cooperation.

earnings_insights: SK Hynix 3Q operating profit reported at W83.3tn versus BBGe consensus W76.9tn and GSe W77.5tn, an 8% beat (reported 28 Oct pre-open).
SK Hynix 2026 total shareholder return W100tn including a W20tn buyback. The buyback was below the Street consensus estimate of W30tn-W40tn.
SEMCO 3Q operating profit reported at W691bn versus BBGe consensus W660.2bn, a 5% beat.
Samsung Electronics (SEC) 3Q earnings call is scheduled for tomorrow (29 Oct) at 10AM KST.
risk_factors: SK Hynix's buyback of W20tn came in below the W30tn-W40tn Street expectation, which weighed on the initial reaction.
Investor focus on Samsung's 3Q call tomorrow for additional shareholder return detail creates event risk if management does not provide it.
vol_and_positioning: Foreigners and local institutions were joint net buyers in SK Hynix (+$288mn foreigners, +$177mn locals) and Samsung Electronics (+$280mn, +$297mn), while retail investors took profits (-$463mn in Hynix, -$564mn in Samsung).
KOSPI foreign flow +$609mn, locals +$718mn, retail -$1,346mn. KOSDAQ foreign -$137mn, locals +$168mn, retail -$23mn.

tension_points.bull_case: Total 2026 shareholder return of W100tn was in line with estimates, and management said the memory shortage will last through 2030 with DRAM capacity sold out through 2029, which lifted the stock 10.9%.
tension_points.bear_case: The W20tn buyback was below the W30tn-W40tn Street consensus, which produced a mild initial reaction before the conference call.

theme_stances.key_argument: SK Hynix's 3Q beat and management commentary on a multi-year memory shortage helped restore investor confidence in AI and lifted KOSPI above 6,000.
